cooked: One useful next step would be to make the differential boundary explicit in CI: pin the Bitcoin Core revision and list which consensus questions the current kernel calls can and cannot answer. Matching transaction-local checks is a strong result, but it does not yet cover script execution against a UTXO set or block-context rules. That distinction will help readers interpret future coverage and any mismatch.
